meetings.title: Fee schedule discussion
meetings.summary: Fee schedule discussion with Susan Delgado tied to the Capital Group New Perspective mandate now in finals. Delgado confirmed the proposed fees are acceptable; relationship healthy.

decisions.text: Accept the proposed fee schedule and proceed toward the finals presentation.

transcript_excerpt.text: The fee schedule works for us - let's keep moving toward finals.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Renee Lambert
transcript_excerpt.text: Great - we'll be ready for the finals presentation.
